_secrets_note: This channel's own OAuth client_secret.json + token.json (gitignored). Login: python tools/yt_auth.py <channel_key>
_publish_note: shared/RULES.md section 8 (2026-10-21): decided right after the upload from the IST clock. Long: 19:00-23:59 -> public now, 00:00-18:59 -> 19:00 same day; one long per day (else next free day). Short of a long: long + 60 min (19:00 -> 20:00; after 23:59 -> public now). api_audited false -> upload private + STUDIO ACTION message; true -> tools/youtube_upload.py sets public/publishAt itself.
_format_note: User 2026-10-24 FINAL: no recitation audio (human or AI), very soft instrumental music (RULES 1c, from 2026-10-24); order: surah parichay -> shan-e-nuzul (sourced) -> aayat-dar-aayat (Arabic on screen + Hindi tarjuma + simple meaning) -> seekh. No image/silhouette of any Prophet or Sahabi. channels/noor-e-raah/RULES.md

voices._help: RULES 1b (user 2026-10-24): two speakers in a conversation; audition characters/voices/audition_2026-10-24/

ustaad.role: aayat, bhaavarth, matlab, parichay, shan-e-nuzul (only voice for religious claims)
ustaad.style: Calm, respectful Indian Hindi-Urdu teacher explaining the Quran to a family in everyday language: warm, steady and clear, correct Urdu nuqta sounds (ज़, फ़, क़, ख़, ग़), unhurried pace, gentle reverence, no drama, never singing or chanting

sawaal.role: aam aadmi ke sawaal, misaal, chhota saar
sawaal.style: Soft, respectful, curious Indian Hindi-speaking woman asking simple everyday questions and telling a short real-life example: natural, warm, conversational, correct Urdu nuqta sounds, never singing or chanting

music._help: RULES 1c (user 2026-10-24). Sources only: YouTube Audio Library (shared/music/noor/, licence type noted), Incompetech (CC BY), Pixabay backup; every track in shared/assets_license.csv
music.ayah_on_screen: music fade-out 1 s, light ambience only; music back slowly after the ayah
music._tracks_note: Empty until the user picks (2026-10-24). Options + samples: channels/noor-e-raah/music_samples/ (files in shared/music/noor/_options/, git-ignored). Only picked tracks go to shared/assets_license.csv.
